title: `static::NAME` reads the called class's constant at run time
scope:
what a `static::` class-constant read answers, and the four refusals that make the
run-time read sound. `self::`, `parent::` and named-class constant reads stay inlined and are
unchanged; `static::` on a method, on `::class` and in `new static()` are [0144](0144.md)'s.
validatedBy:
`tests/conformance/class/a-static-constant-read-answers-the-called-class.nvst` and the four reject cases
named in the rule's `guardedBy`.
